title: install-local: after a restart an installed package's connector never materializes — the `kernel:ready` rehydrate runs after automation's boot reconcile and announces no reload
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (a) (reproducible). Found by the os-dev on #28534 (PR #28587, dev report on #28534) with a throwaway dogfood probe; re-read by this seat. Child of #27293 (E4: a connector app installed from the shelf must survive a restart). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` public doors — `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with an inline manifest declaring a provider-bound `openapi` connector that carries an INLINE document. Before the restart, the connector is listed `ready` on `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors`. Then restart the runtime on the same install ledger. The package is rehydrated and is listed by `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, but the connector is absent from `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors`. Measured by the dev at `71597f1b`: two `bootShowcase` boots over one `storageDir`. The inline entry never reaches PR #28587's changed code, so that PR neither causes nor fixes this.

## The defect (mechanism as the dev read it; this seat re-read the comments at `origin/main` `617dcf43`)

- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:128` re-registers each cached manifest on `kernel:ready`.
- `service-automation` runs its only boot reconcile (fatal mode) in `start()`, before `kernel:ready`.
- The rehydrate path does not call `announceHotInstall` (`:3933`; only the install path calls it, at `:2073`). No `metadata:reloaded` therefore follows the rehydrate, and no reconcile reads the rehydrated connector entries until some unrelated reload happens.

## Work

Measure first, with the dogfood harness the dev used: install, restart on the same ledger, then list connectors. Then make the rehydrated entries reach a connector reconcile. Either the rehydrate announces a reload once after it registers its packages (one announce for the whole batch, not one per package), or automation reconciles again on `kernel:ready`, whichever fits how the other hot-install consumers (flows, triggers) already learn about rehydrated packages. Check those consumers too: if flows of an installed package are also missing after a restart, say so in the report. Tests: a restart dogfood case (the instance is listed after the second boot), plus a host connector that stays listed (control). Ablate once.

## Business reason

#27293's Done-when is an administrator installing a connector app and dispatching it. Today it works until the first restart (a deploy, a crash, scale-out), after which every installed connector app silently stops, and its flows fail at dispatch.

## Reader

The triage seat grades and routes it (`domain:server`, `cloud-connection` / `service-automation`); the epic PM of #27293 dispatches.

## Dedupe

The 500 most recent issues and PRs (read 2026-11-01T07:03Z), titles grepped for `rehydrat|after restart|restart.*connector`: 2 hits, #28418 and #28143. Both concern install-local's datasource-name holder check on rehydrate, not connector materialization. Control `connector`: 53 hits.
